strongest_angle: Parkwood Entertainment filed court papers in October 2026 asking a California federal judge to impose financial penalties and dismiss a second objectively baseless lawsuit regarding the track Alien Superstar.

key_facts.fact: Parkwood Entertainment filed court papers in California on October 15, 2026, asking a federal judge to impose financial penalties and permanently dismiss the second lawsuit.
Beyoncé's label Parkwood Entertainment targeted the former label boss and his attorney over tangled and conflicting copyright claims regarding the 2022 Renaissance track Alien Superstar.
Music Business Worldwide reported on October 21, 2026, that Beyoncé's company Parkwood Entertainment wants the plaintiff and lawyer to pay legal bills for an objectively baseless second lawsuit.
Law Commentary reported on October 20, 2026, that Beyoncé's entertainment company accused a music copyright owner and his attorney of making contradictory ownership claims.
